name: gavi-video
description: Anúncio vertical de 24s do Inglês com a Gavi, programado em React + Remotion.

scripts.editorial: remotion still CidadeDia public/editorial/cidade-dia.png --image-format=png && remotion still SalaDia public/editorial/sala-dia.png --image-format=png && remotion still CidadeNoite public/editorial/cidade-noite.png --image-format=png && remotion still SalaNoite public/editorial/sala-noite.png --image-format=png
scripts.audio: tsx scripts/compose-audio.ts && tsx scripts/compose-variations.ts && tsx scripts/reels/audio.ts
scripts.assets: npm run editorial && npm run audio
scripts.render: npm run assets && npm run render:claro && npm run render:escuro && npm run render:post && npm run render:noticia && npm run render:conversa && npm run render:pordentro && npm run render:carreira && npm run render:carreirabio
scripts.render:claro: remotion render GaviAdClaro out/.video-claro.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-claro.mp4 public/audio/trilha.wav out/gavi-anuncio-24s-claro.mp4
scripts.render:escuro: remotion render GaviAdEscuro out/.video-escuro.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-escuro.mp4 public/audio/trilha.wav out/gavi-anuncio-24s-escuro.mp4
scripts.render:post: remotion render GaviPost out/.video-post.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-post.mp4 public/audio/post.wav out/gavi-post-24s.mp4
scripts.render:noticia: remotion render GaviNoticia out/.video-noticia.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-noticia.mp4 public/audio/noticia.wav out/gavi-noticia-24s.mp4
scripts.render:conversa: remotion render GaviConversa out/.video-conversa.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-conversa.mp4 public/audio/conversa.wav out/gavi-conversa-24s.mp4
scripts.render:pordentro: remotion render GaviPorDentro out/.video-pordentro.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-pordentro.mp4 public/audio/pordentro.wav out/gavi-pordentro-16s.mp4
scripts.render:carreira: remotion render GaviCarreira out/.video-carreira.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-carreira.mp4 public/audio/carreira.wav out/gavi-carreira-43s.mp4
scripts.render:carreirabio: remotion render GaviCarreiraBio out/.video-carreirabio.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts out/.video-carreirabio.mp4 public/audio/carreira.wav out/gavi-carreira-43s-linknabio.mp4
scripts.verify: tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-anuncio-24s-claro.mp4 && tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-anuncio-24s-escuro.mp4 && tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-post-24s.mp4 public/audio/post.cues.json && tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-noticia-24s.mp4 public/audio/noticia.cues.json && tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-conversa-24s.mp4 public/audio/conversa.cues.json && tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-pordentro-16s.mp4 public/audio/pordentro.cues.json && tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-carreira-43s.mp4 public/audio/carreira.cues.json && tsx scripts/verify.ts out/gavi-carreira-43s-linknabio.mp4 public/audio/carreira.cues.json && tsx scripts/reels/check.ts
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run verify
